scenario.name: the-city-50
scenario.objective: Run a 50-round long-session DND test in the city setting and verify continuity, tool stability, combat progress, and response quality.
scenario.seed_prompt: Start in the city: endless black, gray, and white concrete halls, static morning sun, two moons, slip doors, missing histories, and deep structural rumbling.
milestones: Create or confirm a player character without repeatedly asking for already supplied fields.
Establish the current scene inside the city and preserve it across turns.
Trigger at least one exploration sequence and one combat or danger sequence.
Ask status and recall questions to verify memory and state consistency.
End with a coherent summary of known locations, NPCs, enemies, and pending goals.
